end.summary:
Linked harvest festivals with the season when new crops are ready; answered this correctly twice without help.
Named regional festivals including Bihu, Baisakhi, Pongal, Makar Sankranti, and Onam.
Identified that festivals and celebrations can differ across regions; answered correctly in four attempts.
Did not yet describe a regional festival celebration fully using food, clothes, decorations, or flowers.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Kavya practised linking harvest festivals to the time when crops are ready and recognising that festivals are celebrated differently across regions. They used the new-rice example for Pongal and later connected harvest festivals with new crops; their understanding of regional differences was clear through examples such as Onam, Bihu, and Ganesh Chaturthi. Earlier, they mixed up the idea that festivals can happen at any time and did not yet give a complete description of one regional celebration. At home, ask them to describe one festival using four details: food, clothes, decorations, and flowers.
